column1: POWERACT Consulting · journi Deliverables Structure — Full Specs (D11-D29)

column3: Every object class (D09) is backed by durable server-side storage, never browser localStorage alone.
column11: The single requirement every other D32 spec and every D13 requirement implicitly assumes. Closes the Section 2.4 gap directly.

column3: Automated daily backup of all tenant data, retained per the D09 Retention_Period on the underlying object class.
column11: Backup cadence is uniform; retention length varies per object class per D09's own Retention_Period field — backups don't override that policy, they enforce it.

column3: Production, Staging, and Sandbox environments are fully isolated — no shared database, no shared credentials.
column11: Sandbox is the environment referenced by D02 MP-05 training tasks (Module 10) — must never contain real tenant data.
OnPrem deployments (D30) are excluded from this target — availability is the customer's own infrastructure responsibility there.

column3: Planned maintenance windows communicated in advance.
Every tenant-scoped table partitions by organization_id (or cm_project_id) as its primary partition key.
column11: Directly realizes D12's stated partition-key design principle at the infrastructure level, not just the schema level.

column3: Data residency is configurable per deployment — e.g., Moroccan borders for SaaS deployments requiring it.
column11: Directly supports the Morocco Market Entry Strategy's Cloud SaaS deployment mode (Moroccan data residency).

column3: Infrastructure health (uptime, error rate, latency) is monitored continuously with alerting on breach.
A documented, tested disaster-recovery runbook exists and is exercised at least annually.
